That sounds like a wonderful and thoughtful morning routine! Taking the time to do your makeup the way you like can really set a positive tone for the day. If you enjoy the process and it makes you feel put-together, that’s something to be proud of. Plus, the care you put into blending foundation and fixing your eyeliner shows attention to detail and self-respect. Keep doing what makes you feel good!
